after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.data: Yahoo daily closes: SPY adjusted for dividends and splits, ^IRX as published; each file's sha256 in the manifest; a missing day is not filled: a month without all its days is no trade

gates.book_pays: the managed book's own mean monthly excess return, net, > 0
gates.costs_x2: alpha > 0 with the trading cost and the markup doubled
gates.t: White t of the managed book's monthly alpha on the market, 1995..2021, >= the threshold
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total alpha

spec.holdout_rule: 2022-01..2026-09: alpha > 0 with one-sided White t >= 1.645, alpha > 0 with the costs doubled, and the managed book's own mean monthly excess return > 0
spec.question: does scaling S&P 500 exposure by the inverse of last month's realised variance earn a positive alpha on the market, after a retail CFD's costs?
spec.rule: exposure for month m+1 = mean RV of months up to m / RV of m, capped at 2; RV = sum of squared daily returns in the month; held for the month, its drift traded back at the next month's last close
spec.test: OLS of the managed book's monthly net excess return on the market's (both pay the short rate plus the markup on their exposure), White standard errors
